title: sessinspect
summary: Read-only inspector for Claude Code session evidence. Use to answer a specific question about past agent sessions (what tools ran, what failed, which files were touched, how context was used) instead of loading raw transcripts into context. Every command supports --json; run `sessinspect --help` for the current command set.

source.note: Published as its own package repository. Promoted from the private cc-session-inspector research repository, which remains the historical record of the tool's development and is not published.
